name: FUN_STREAM_TYPES_B
description: This table contains mapping of functional processes with the specific business flow context.

columns.name: STREAM_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Functional process stream types unique identifier.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Reference identifier for the business application.

columns.name: FLOW_NAME
columns.description: Purchase or sales transaction flow.

columns.name: PROCESS_NAME
columns.description: Name of an automated business process.

columns.name: STREAM_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The code for a business job stream.

columns.name: MASTER_STREAM_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies if a job represents a thematic collection of interrelated jobs.

columns.name: PREPROCESS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Process type executed before the stream (Java or PL/SQL).

columns.name: PREPROCESS_PACKAGE
columns.description: Full path of the Java or PL/SQL package.

columns.name: PREPROCESS_API
columns.description: Java method or PL/SQL procedure details.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_ROLE_CODE
columns.description: Role code for which a notification will be issued for a successful process.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of process success notification, such as bell or bell and e-mail,  provided to inform users.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_PROCESS_URL
columns.description: Notification task flow used to support bell notifications for a successful process.

columns.name: ERROR_NOTIFICATION_ROLE_CODE
columns.description: Role code for which a notification will be issued for a failed process.

columns.name: ERROR_NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of process error notification, such as bell or bell and e-mail,  provided to inform users.

columns.name: ERROR_NOTIFICATION_PROCESS_URL
columns.description: Notification task flow used to support bell notifications for a failed process.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_FLAG
columns.description: The designation for the notification sent on the success or the  failure of a business process.

columns.name: INITIATION_EVENT
columns.description: The event which triggers this business process.

columns.name: COMPLETION_EVENT
columns.description: The event which is triggered when this business process completes successfully.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether automation processing is enabled.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded, or defined by the user.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
